about.title:
Not an agency.
A person in your corner.
about.description: From our first conversation to launch day, you’ll only ever deal with me. Together we’ll figure out the direction, then I’ll design your website and build it too. No handing the work off to someone else along the way. It’s one shared journey, from start to finish.
about.detail: And if you need original photos, I’ll bring my camera along.

process.title:
Good work starts
with good questions.

steps.title: Start with a conversation
steps.description: We talk about your business, your customers and what needs to change. The first calls are free and with no obligation.

steps.title: Find the right direction
steps.description: We agree on the offer, scope and visual direction before design begins.

steps.title: Bring it to life
steps.description: Design, content and development come together, with your feedback along the way.

steps.title: Launch with confidence
steps.description: We test, refine and launch — then agree on the support you need next.

faq.title:
Before we
get started.
faq.note:
Still wondering about something?
Let’s talk it through.

items.question: How much does a project cost?
items.answer: It depends on what you need and how big the project is. We usually talk it through over two or three calls, and at the end I’ll send you a quote with a clear scope.

items.question: How long does a website take?
items.answer: The timeline depends on the size of the project and how ready the content is. We agree on milestones and feedback points before work begins.

items.question: Can we work together on just one service?
items.answer: Yes. We can focus on your brand, website or photography — or bring them together if that’s what your business needs.

items.question: Do I need to prepare all the content?
items.answer: You don’t need everything ready to start a conversation. We’ll look at what you already have and decide where copy or original photography would help.

items.question: What happens after launch?
items.answer: We agree on a handover and any ongoing support as part of the project. If your business changes, we can revisit the website and plan the next improvements.
